thread:
jamie: Heads-up — I tried to kick off the production push for release 2026.3 and the deploy-gatekeeper blocked me: 'MFA not present for role prod-deployer'. Anyone else hit this?

deploy-bot: Deploy request blocked by gatekeeper v2.1. Reason: missing MFA for role=prod-deployer. Trace ID: db-1796001122-7f.

jamie: Ugh. I thought my account had the new role after the rotation last week. I can see prod-deployer in IAM but maybe MFA not enrolled.

ops-lead: @jamie yep we rolled a stricter check yesterday to enforce hardware 2FA for prod-deployer. Security asked for it after the last emergency push. Sorry for the breakage. :lock:

maria: Quick Q — is this enforced at the gatekeeper layer only or also on the deployer service? Trying to triage for potential rollback/no-op flows.

ryan: Gatekeeper enforces it pre-accept; deployer will never get the job if gatekeeper rejects. So this blocks earlier which is good.

jamie: I have a hotfix that needs to go out in the next hour. Can we do a one-off exemption? I have a pager shift conflict so can't enroll MFA right now.

ops-lead: We can do an emergency exception but policy requires a second approver from SRE and an audit trail. @samantha can you approve an exception for jamie? We need the ticket ID and reason.

samantha: Can approve if it's a real emergency. Please open a quick ticket with details and add me as approver. Also we need recorded signoff in the thread.

jamie: Ticket created — TICKET-4321. Reason: urgent customer-facing search regression; mitigated risk with canary 5% and immediate rollback plan. Adding @samantha and @ryan.

ryan: I can be second approver. Checklist: 1) confirm fix, 2) verify test pass on staging, 3) manual canary, 4) monitoring runbook ready. I ran unit tests locally, staging looks good.

ops-lead: Ok approved for one-off. Exception granted for job id db-1796001122-7f. Conditions: jamie must perform the push during the change window 14:00-15:00 UTC, @samantha and @ryan on-call during push, and we attach the audit logs. This exception will be revoked after the deploy.

deploy-bot: Exception logged. Exception ID: ex-2026-1796001122. Audit will capture gatekeeper decision and approvers.

maria: For follow-up: we should reduce friction — either guide people through MFA onboarding or add a small self-serve wizard in the console to enroll hardware tokens. This keep the security posture.

jamie: Agreed. I'll enroll after the push. Proposing a short doc snippet for the onboarding flow.

samantha: Please add a follow-up card to the infra backlog: 'prod-deployer MFA onboarding UX' and @maria assign. Also add a post-mortem note under release 2026.3.

ryan: One more ops nit: update the runbook to include the exact gatekeeper error text to speed triage: `MFA not present for role prod-deployer`.

ops-lead: Noted. Also we should pin a fallback deployer role for emergency ops (with stricter audit) — ticketed as INFRA-1287.

jamie: Running the manual canary now. Command I used: `./rdeploy --env production --release 2026.3 --canary 5 --trace db-1796001122-7f`

deploy-bot: Canary started. Canaries: 5%. Monitor at https://console/redwood/releases/2026.3/canary db link.

maria: Watching metrics — latency and error rate stable so far. No anomalous logs.

ryan: Canary looks clean at +12m. Proceeding to full push in 10m per the checklist.

jamie: Full push done. Logs show successful rollout. Thank you for the quick approval.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed. Release: 2026.3. Rollout: 100%. Audit: ex-2026-1796001122 attached.

samantha: Marking exception closed. Please follow up with MFA enrollment within 24 hours, @jamie.

jamie: Will do — enrolling tonight. Also documenting the step-by-step in the release notes for the team.

maria: Thanks team. Action items: INFRA-1287 (fallback role), UX card for MFA onboarding, update runbook.

ops-lead: Closing thread — great cross-team coordination. :tada:
